    • validateAndResolvePathWithinRoot

      public static Path validateAndResolvePathWithinRoot(String rootPath, Path path) throws IOException
      Validates that a path stays within the user's root directory, guarding against path traversal. Existing paths are resolved through symbolic links; for a non-existent path the existing parent directory is resolved instead so the intended location can still be checked.
      Parameters:
      rootPath - the root directory of the user, used as a security boundary, as String
      path - the path to validate
      Returns:
      The resolved path
      Throws:
      IOException - if the real path cannot be resolved
      InvalidPathException - if the path resolves outside the user's root directory

    • validateAndResolvePathWithinRoot

      public static Path validateAndResolvePathWithinRoot(Path rootReal, Path path) throws IOException
      Validates that a path stays within the user's root directory, guarding against path traversal. Existing paths are resolved through symbolic links; for a non-existent path the existing parent directory is resolved instead so the intended location can still be checked.
      Parameters:
      rootReal - the root directory of the user, used as a security boundary
      path - the path to validate
      Returns:
      The resolved path
      Throws:
      IOException - if the real path cannot be resolved
      InvalidPathException - if the path resolves outside the user's root directory

    • validateStorageSizeWithinQuota

      public static void validateStorageSizeWithinQuota(String rootPath, long additionalBytes, Long quotaMb) throws IOException
      Ensures that adding bytes to active storage would not exceed the owner's storage quota.
      Parameters:
      rootPath - the root directory of the user
      additionalBytes - the number of bytes to add to active storage
      quotaMb - the storage quota in megabytes, or null for no quota
      Throws:
      IOException - if the directory tree cannot be traversed
      IllegalArgumentException - if the additional storage would exceed the quota

    • calculateDirectorySize

      public static long calculateDirectorySize(Path path) throws IOException
      Calculates active storage usage by recursively summing regular files outside the root's .trash directory. Files whose size cannot be read are skipped.
      Parameters:
      path - the directory to measure
      Returns:
      the total size in bytes of all regular files under path, or 0 if the path does not exist
      Throws:
      IOException - if the directory tree cannot be traversed
